map.犬猫出现咳嗽/打喷嚏/流涕时，结合体温与精神症状，快速得到上呼吸道感染、犬瘟/猫: When a dog or cat shows cough/sneezing/nasal discharge, combined with temperature and mental symptoms, quickly obtain differential directions such as upper respiratory infection, canine distemper/feline panleukopenia, etc.
map.呕吐+腹泻且幼龄发热时，优先排查细小病毒等传染病，并给出应做的抗原/血常规检查。: When vomiting+diarrhea occurs with fever in a young animal, prioritize ruling out infectious diseases such as parvovirus, and suggest the antigen/CBC tests to perform.
map.猫出现排尿异常时，结合品种与症状提示猫下泌尿道疾病（FLUTD）风险，指导就医检: When a cat shows abnormal urination, combined with breed and symptoms it indicates the risk of feline lower urinary tract disease (FLUTD) and guides the examinations to seek.
map.一只犬体温 39.8℃（犬正常 37.5–39.2℃，属发热），勾选咳嗽+流涕+: A dog with temperature 39.8°C (normal dog 37.5-39.2°C, indicating fever), checking cough+nasal discharge+lethargy: the tool pushes 'canine distemper/feline panleukopenia (viral infectious disease)' as high probability, suggesting CDV antigen test and CBC; it also indicates 'upper respiratory infection' as medium probability. Note: this result is for reference only; confirmation requires laboratory testing.
map.这个工具能代替医生诊断吗？: Can this tool replace a veterinarian's diagnosis?
map.不能。它基于症状组合给出“疑似方向与建议检查/处置”，帮助主人判断紧急程度与就医: No. It gives 'suspected directions and suggested examinations/treatments' based on symptom combinations, helping owners judge urgency and care priorities; the final diagnosis must be determined by a veterinarian through physical examination and lab tests.
